answer.text:
For an affordable hot-swappable mechanical keyboard with USB-C, the Cosmic Byte CB-GK-42 Phantom TKL is a strong, feature-rich option available under 4000 INR.
Recommended Option
Cosmic Byte CB-GK-42 Phantom TKL
Layout: Tenkeyless (TKL), compact yet functional for most typing and gaming needs.
Switches: Pre-lubed Outemu Red mechanical switches; fully hot-swappable, allowing you to swap 3-pin switches without soldering.
Connectivity: Wired with USB-C for fast and stable connection.
Polling Rate: 1000Hz, suitable for gaming responsiveness.
Keycaps & Lighting: Per-key RGB backlighting, software support for customization.
Extras: Volume roller and software customization for macros and lighting effects.
Price: Under 4000 INR on Amazon.in, making it accessible for budget-conscious users seeking hot-swappable functionality.
Other Options to Consider
While the Cosmic Byte CB-GK-42 stands out for budget pricing, Keychron K8 and Keychron K4 are notable alternatives if you can slightly increase your budget or find promotions. These models support USB-C, hot-swappable 3/5-pin switches, RGB lighting, and multi-device wireless connectivity, but they typically retail above 4000 INR unless discounted Setupgamers.
Buying Tips
Check for 3-pin/5-pin compatibility: Ensures maximum flexibility for different mechanical switch types.
Layout preference: TKL is compact and suitable for most desks, full-size includes a numpad.
Connectivity: USB-C is standard on modern boards, offering stable data and future-proofing.
Backlighting & software: Customizable RGB and macro software can enhance typing/gaming experience.
Local availability & shipping: Confirm delivery to Urgench, Uzbekistan, through local Amazon partners or import services.
In summary, for under 4000 INR, the Cosmic Byte CB-GK-42 Phantom TKL is your best bet for a hot-swappable USB-C mechanical keyboard, offering reliable build quality, customizable switches, and RGB lighting while keeping the price budget-friendly .
